title: Monken on Deshaun Watson, Browns QB battle: 'Players decide who plays'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Monken on Deshaun Watson, Browns QB battle: 'Players decide who plays'
sources.description: The Browns are set for another QB competition this offseason and new HC Todd Monken says it is 'completely unfair' to count out Deshaun Watson.
